content.short: Typus is a real-yield options protocol on Sui featuring automated DeFi Option Vaults (DOVs).
content.description:
Typus Finance is a leading decentralized options and derivatives protocol built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to maximize rewards for users through sophisticated risk management. The platform features automated DeFi Option Vaults (DOVs) that utilize a Dutch auction mechanism to simplify options trading for retail participants. This allows users to earn "real yield" generated from actual market demand for volatility, rather than relying on inflationary token emissions.

Deeply integrated with the Sui ecosystem, Typus features the "Tails by Typus" dynamic NFT collection, which provides holders with boosted rewards and exclusive platform benefits. By leveraging Sui's high throughput and sub-second finality, Typus delivers a seamless and highly responsive trading experience that rivals centralized platforms while maintaining the security of on-chain settlement. Through its commitment to financial innovation and user-centric design, Typus is building the essential framework for the next generation of decentralized options and structured products.
content.meta: Typus provides automated DeFi Option Vaults and high-efficiency real-yield strategies on the Sui blockchain.
